question: How does solar power cut emissions?

sources.title: Solar power
sources.content: Solar generation produces electricity without operational carbon emissions.

sources.title: Battery storage
sources.content: Battery storage shifts electricity from periods of surplus to periods of demand.

sources.title: Heat pumps
sources.content: Heat pumps move heat rather than creating it through combustion.

sources.title: Wind turbines
sources.content: Wind turbines convert the kinetic energy of moving air into electricity.

question: What is the benefit of insulation?

sources.title: Insulation
sources.content: Insulation slows heat transfer through a building envelope.

sources.title: LED lighting
sources.content: LED lamps use less electricity than incandescent lamps for equivalent light.

sources.title: Free cooling
sources.content: Free cooling uses suitable outdoor conditions to reduce mechanical chiller use.

sources.title: Reforestation
sources.content: Growing forests remove carbon dioxide from the atmosphere through photosynthesis.

question: How can public transit reduce traffic?

sources.title: Public transit
sources.content: High-capacity public transit can carry more people using fewer vehicles.

question: How does drip irrigation conserve water?

sources.title: Drip irrigation
sources.content: Drip irrigation applies water near plant roots and limits evaporation losses.

sources.title: Aluminum recycling
sources.content: Recycling aluminum requires less energy than producing primary aluminum from ore.
